title: DataMimicAI
summary: DataMimicAI is a no-code Streamlit/FastAPI platform for generating and validating privacy-preserving synthetic tabular and time-series data, offering multiple modeling backends. Its core generation engine directly imports and instantiates SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, HMASynthesizer and PARSynthesizer (plus SingleTableMetadata and evaluation plotting), making SDV the load-bearing synthesis library behind the app's 'Standard SDV Models' feature.
